findings.passage: If we want to have people engaged, we must make it easier for people to cast a vote and not put more stipulations on them. I fully support making voting more accessible to more people. We all should be working to register as many people as possible as well as expanding voting rights and ways to vote.
findings.note: Her written answer to a Kentuckians For The Commonwealth questionnaire from her House run (listed as KY House 42). Question 3 read: "During 2020, Kentuckians voted in large numbers as a result of mail-in absentee voting and early voting. What is your view on modernizing state election laws? Specifically, do you support allowing early voting, mail-in ballots without excuses, same-day voter registration, extended hours at polling locations, offering ballots in multiple languages, and other election reforms?" She names no ID or citizenship rule. Date not shown on the page; it follows the 2020 election.
